author: ClubberNugget
body:
Hello Seniors,

According to one moderator and one senior moderator, combat logging is legal on TDM maps on a scrimmage server, is this true?  If so, why? I understand combat logging being legal on any other map, but on TDM, that's breaking the game.  Thanks.

title: Combat logging on a scrim (TDM only)

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body: Players are allowed to combat log on scrim servers, regardless of the gamemode being played. To be honest, the team would gain the advantage if someone were to combat log on the opposite team. This is because they would lose a player, even if it were to be for a short amount of time. The team leaders would be responsible for the players in their team that combat log. Also, you don't gain any credits on scrim servers like you do in public matches, so it wouldn't matter as much.
